presence.repeated_empty: Original None and Some(empty) are not distinguishable after convert.rs unwrap_or_default. No missing balance is a zero balance.
presence.scalars: Proto3 omitted scalar fields have decoded defaults; wire presence is retained separately. An omitted nested UiTokenAmount message remains unavailable, not a constructed zero observation.
presence.repeated_singular_fields: Protobuf last scalar occurrence and singular message merge semantics apply; the exact original nested bytes remain preserved.
presence.integer_limits: The source Rust type uses u8 account index/decimals and amount is a u64 decimal string. This projection checks these bounds and does not reproduce convert.rs truncation or failed parse fallback to zero.
presence.ui_amount: The double and display string are retained as raw source bytes/fields only. Neither is a canonical token quantity.

trade_context: An additive metadata unit/balance correspondence does not change prior trade admission, prove an account snapshot, CPI privileges, an individual instruction delta, quote identity, prices, fees or execution.
